source.lemmas: Authored for icanspeak Spanish in Castilian Spanish (variety es-ES; es419 notes where Latin America differs), chosen by topic for CEFR A2, with what a resident of Spain needs first. Level banding is our own, NOT the Instituto Cervantes Plan Curricular (PCIC): the UI must not claim otherwise. gender = singular definite article: el / la / el/la (common-gender person nouns).
